headline: California launches probe into Nvidia over China chip sales
standfirst: State regulators are investigating the AI chip giant's business practices.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: California officials are investigating Nvidia regarding its AI chip sales to China.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The probe begins shortly after the departure of the company's former CEO, Jensen Huang.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Nvidia is based in California. This action brings state oversight to global tech trade issues.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Watch for official findings from state investigators as the probe progresses.

caption:
California is investigating the AI chipmaker Nvidia over its sales to China.

State regulators have opened an inquiry into the company's trade practices. This news follows the recent departure of former CEO Jensen Huang. We are tracking how this state-level probe impacts the global AI market.
